entry.title: Wildcard Routing with Cloudflare Email Forwarding
entry.summary: If you have your own domain name but are cheap like me and don't want to pay for a third party service you can use Cloudflare to route your emails to your gmail address. (And after reading this quick post, can forward even plus suffixed email addresses to your gmail account.
